data.narrative:
Atana Elements is a seed-stage climate & energy company founded by Tom Wilson that has raised $27.5M to date. The valuation exercise draws on a comp universe of 9 private peers in Climate & Energy (including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen) alongside 1 public comparable (LNZA), though narrow peer filtering yielded insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage matches for robust median benchmarking.

Stage-progression analysis, the only applicable triangulation method, uses the $27.5M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a typical 2.5x seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier, implying a valuation of $69M. This method is grounded in observed capital progression patterns but relies on the assumption that Atana's funding trajectory and investor composition align with sector norms.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $58M (low) to $79M (high), with a median of $69M. Key uncertainties stem from the sparse peer set at this stage and the absence of disclosed recent seed-round comparable terms in the narrower Climate & Energy frontier-tech cohort. Refinement would benefit from additional recent seed or Series A closings in the sector, or disclosure of investor syndication patterns and post-money terms from peer financings.
